role: M11 target freshness/access custodian; not a generator

recommended_target.linkage: SEQN; custodian only; replace with opaque row_id for builders

survey_design.weight_rationale: CDC directs use of the phlebotomy weight for blood analytes in this cycle; it addresses phlebotomy nonresponse. WTMEC2YR is not the primary HbA1c weight.

recommended_target.source_eligibility: Examined participants aged 12 years and older; both sexes. BMI metadata covers age 2 and older.
recommended_target.proposed_adult_scope: Age 20 through 79 inclusive, preserving continuous reported age and avoiding the 80-year topcode; root must freeze final selection before row parsing.
recommended_target.age_metadata: RIDAGEYR is screening age; all participants aged 80 years and older are topcoded to 80.
recommended_target.pregnancy_metadata: RIDEXPRG publicly covers females aged 20 through 44; pregnancy exclusion and unknown handling must be fixed before preparation.
recommended_target.fasting: No fasting subsample restriction is specified by the GHB component eligibility.
recommended_target.measurement_metadata: Whole-blood HbA1c. Within-cycle equipment changed from Tosoh G8 to Bio-Rad D-100. CDC states no correction is needed. No numeric method-comparison or participant summaries are retained here.
recommended_target.missingness: Proposed complete-case availability only on the permitted variables, valid sex coding, positive finite design weight, and finite measured target; no target-magnitude, diagnostic, or proxy selection. Final rule awaits root freeze.
recommended_target.sample_size: Not inspected; no participant data downloaded or parsed in this audit.
recommended_target.builder_boundary: Only opaque row_id, age_years, sex, bmi_kg_m2 plus approved external sources. Omit LBXGH, proxies, diagnoses, source IDs, design columns, and all other participant columns.

freshness.decision: Recommend 2021-2023 as project-unexposed for HbA1c target evaluation under this bounded audit, with explicit limitations below.
freshness.rejection_reason: Existing 2017 GHB_J acquisition manifest and preparation code identify HbA1c as a measured outcome in a prior local temporal-prediction project. 2015 GHB_I is also present. No prior outcome values or numerical results were read.
freshness.previous_virtual_cohort_hba1c_target: PNS 2013 survey laboratory release, prepared in M9 and used in M10; outcome tables and figures were not opened.
freshness.same_cycle_other_target_exposure: NHANES 2021-2023 TRIGLY_L, DEMO_L, BMX_L are present in the structure-robustness project. Thus the survey and covariates are not wholly new; target-specific HbA1c use is the fresh element.
freshness.candidate_file_search: No GHB_L participant file found in the audited biomedical_research filenames. No literal GHB_L appeared in the preexisting searchable text-code audit.
freshness.related_review_mentions: Three-model-review prose and its snapshot contain HbA1c near 2021/2023 strings, but no literal GHB_L or GHB_L URL. Their outcome/relationship prose was not opened; these are recorded as ambiguous planning/review mentions, not proof of a prior target evaluation.
limitations: Cannot establish absence in deleted files, unsaved chats, other workspaces, remote machines, archives not enumerated internally, or model pretraining.
Text content search returned filenames only and excluded binary participant files; it can miss unnamed or differently named prior analyses.
Project-unexposed HbA1c does not mean a new national survey or independence from other NHANES tasks.
The current directory is not a Git repository, so local Git history did not provide a historical audit.

method: rg --files (including hidden files except .git) for names; binary data contents not read
rg -l on text/code extensions for LBXGH, GHB dataset names, and nearby HbA1c/cycle strings; only filenames printed
Read the authorized scientific plan, M9 source/metadata and preparation scripts, and a prior download manifest
Read only matching lines in the prior data preparation code to classify cycle and target use
Official codebooks and HEAD requests; no XPT GET request

exposure_disclosure.description: An initial web tool open of GHB_J and GHB_L automatically returned their public frequency/range sections with documentation. The custodian saw these public summaries but did not report or save their contents. Subsequent metadata reads filtered out frequency tables. Root was informed immediately.
exposure_disclosure.plan_read: The explicitly authorized scientific plan includes historical narrative; no historical outcome findings are reproduced here.
exposure_disclosure.builders: This custodian must not serve as a blinded generator; no target summaries, relationships, directions or values are transmitted to builders.

next_authorized_step_required: Root must freeze protocol, selection and builder information boundary and explicitly authorize target preparation before any participant file is downloaded or parsed.
